verdict.rationale: The docs imply a usage-based, non-provisioned default model. Deployments are multi-tenant by default, reserved compute ('namespace pinning') is an opt-in alternative for sustained loads, and indexing cost is metered per attribute (a 50% discount for filterable: false). However, no pricing page or explicit per-unit rates appear in the evidence. missing for 10: an explicit published per-unit price list (storage/write/query rates), first-party confirmation of serverless pay-per-use billing, and independent corroboration of pricing transparency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pay serverless usage-based pricing with transparent per-unit costs instead of provisioning fixed clusters

citations.quote: Namespace pinning provisions reserved compute for a namespace to provide predictable cost and performance for large namespaces with sustained query volume
marking attributes as `filterable: false` will improve indexing performance and grant you a 50% discount
